{{Quote|Several Jedi Knights have invaded this sector and are lending support to anti-Empire rioters. Loyal servants of the Emperor are encouraged to confront these extremists and their meddling Republic allies. Eliminate them with extreme prejudice.<br /><br />Reward will be delivered upon verification that the Jedi at key coordinates have all been neutralized.|The bounty listing|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bounty Listing X489J2''' was a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] issued by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had infiltrated the [[Duros Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
